name: @pipeworx/mcp-datos-gob-es

tools.name: datasets
tools.description: Search the Spanish open data portal (datos.gob.es) catalog by keyword, theme, or both; returns paginated dataset listings with title, publisher, and download links.

tools.name: dataset
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a single datos.gob.es dataset by its ID; returns title, description, publisher, themes, distribution URLs, and license.

tools.name: publishers
tools.description: List public-sector publishers on datos.gob.es (Spanish open data portal); returns publisher names and IDs, up to 50 results.

tools.name: themes
tools.description: List available dataset themes/categories on datos.gob.es (e.g. Economy, Health, Transport); returns theme labels and IDs for use as a filter in the datasets tool.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datos-gob-es forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datos-gob-es pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
